question.text: Let the lines <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mn>11</mn></msqrt><mo>+</mo><mn>7</mn><msqrt><mn>7</mn></msqrt></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mn>11</mn></msqrt><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><msqrt><mn>7</mn></msqrt></math> be normal to a circle <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi><mo>:</mo><msup><mfenced><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>h</mi></mrow></mfenced><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mfenced><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>k</mi></mrow></mfenced><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math>. If the line <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><mn>11</mn></msqrt><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>5</mn><msqrt><mn>77</mn></msqrt></mrow><mn>3</mn></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mn>11</mn></math> is tangent to the circle <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi></math>, then the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>5</mn><mi>h</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>k</mi></mrow></mfenced><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> is equal to ______.

solution.text:
Equations of normal are

y+2x=11+77   ...i

2y+x=211+67   ...ii

Now the center of the circle is point of intersection of the normals i.e. solving i & ii, we get the point of intersection as 

873,11+573≡h,k

The equation of tangent is 11y-3x=5773+11

The radius will be perpendicular distance of tangent from center

i.e. r=11873-311+573-5773-1111+9=475

Hence 5h-8k2+5r2=816
